idea-plugin.name: Metal Shader Support
idea-plugin.description:
Metal Shader Support - Professional GPU Programming for Apple Platforms

⚡ Freemium Plugin - Basic features free, Pro features available with license.

Comprehensive Metal Shading Language (MSL) support for IntelliJ-based IDEs. Build high-performance GPU applications with full Metal 3.2 and Metal 4.0 support.

✨ Key Features

  • Full Metal 3.2 & 4.0 Syntax Highlighting - Advanced semantic highlighting for all Metal versions
  • Metal 4.0 Feature Support - Raytracing, Mesh Shaders, latest GPU features (iOS 18+, macOS 15+)
  • Smart Code Completion - 300+ keywords, types, and functions with documentation
  • Performance Analysis - Real-time optimization hints and complexity analyzer
  • MPS Integration - Metal Performance Shaders auto-completion (50+ classes)
  • Professional Tools - Structure view, find usages, refactoring, code folding
  • Rich Examples - 1,500+ lines of production-ready shader code

🎯 Metal 4.0 Language Features

  • Hardware-accelerated raytracing with acceleration structures
  • Mesh shading pipeline (object & mesh shaders)
  • Advanced atomic operations (atomic_float, atomic_double)
  • 64-bit vector types (long2-4, double2-4)
  • Sparse textures and advanced memory operations
  • Complete syntax support for Metal Shading Language 3.2 and 4.0

🔧 Supported File Types

.metal, .msl, .mm, .h, .hpp

⚡ Performance Tools

  • Real-time performance inspection with optimization hints
  • Shader complexity analyzer (cycles estimation)
  • Thread divergence detection
  • Memory bandwidth analysis
  • Automatic suggestions for vectorization

💡 Perfect For

  • Game developers (Unity, Unreal, custom engines)
  • GPU compute (ML/AI inference, video processing)
  • Graphics programmers (rendering engines, AR/VR)
  • Vision Pro developers

💰 Freemium Licensing

  • Free Tier: Basic syntax, completion, templates
  • Pro Tier: Performance tools, complexity analyzer, advanced features
  • Contact: support@jakubjirak.com for licensing

© 2025 Jakub Jirák. Proprietary software. All rights reserved.

📚 Includes Examples

  • Basic vertex/fragment shaders
  • Compute kernels with threadgroup memory
  • Metal 4 raytracing (path tracing, shadows, AO)
  • Metal 4 mesh shaders (LOD, culling, procedural)
  • Metal Performance Shaders integration
